summary: Level-5's action-RPG and world-building series for PlayStation 2, later rereleased through PlayStation's PS2-on-PS4 program.

entries.title: Dark Cloud

emulation.notes: Use the official PS4 release for the main route; use PCSX2 only with legal disc dumps for testing.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official PS4 up-rendering or higher internal resolution in PCSX2.

primary.why: The PS4 release is an official emulated version with up-rendering and trophies, making it the best simple current route for capture.
primary.how_to_play: Buy/play Dark Cloud on PlayStation Store for PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. Use PCSX2 with a legal PS2 disc dump only for local enhancement comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an emulated PS2 release, not a full remaster.
